_comment: Staff phone directory for WhatsApp routing. Match key is phone9 - the last 9 digits, same normalization as normalizePhone() in whatsapp/ingest/phone.js (strips 972 / leading zeros). 'inAllGroups: true' marks the partner who is a participant of every group (Yaakov Epstein) and must be ignored when picking the responsible staff member. 'defaultOwner' names the admin who receives anything that can't be routed. 'excludeFromStats: true' keeps a person OUT of the response dashboard entirely: no row, and their replies are not counted in the firm median. They stay fully routable and stay in the 'change responsible' list - this flag is about MEASUREMENT only. A chat currently sitting with an excluded person is re-attributed for display to the monday person in charge (and if that is also excluded or missing, to the default owner), so no waiting client message can disappear. 'showFirmLine: false' hides the shared 'Lawly line' row and leaves its replies out of the firm median too.
